items.title: Howard Alden interviewed by Monk Rowe, Aspen, Colorado, October 11, 1997
items.q: next week we’re working a trio with Michael Moore... I love playing with Ken. And Bucky I enjoy playing with... Michael Moore I love playing with too... Michael Moore is still my favorite bass player period... working a week in a club with Ken Peplowski and Michael Moore.

ctx.x: Who are some of your favorite compatriots to work with these days?

Well let’s see, you just talked to one of them, Ken Peplowski. We’ve known each other almost fifteen years, probably about twelve or thirteen years. And we play together quite often both in a duo situation, which is a lot of fun, and next week we’re working a trio with Michael Moore and larger groups too, quartets and stuff like that. He’s great too © Fillius Jazz Archive -8-

because we really do have like a musical conversation when we play. Either one of us can go any way at any time and the other person is fearless enough to attempt to follow or not, as the choice may be. And he’s got the flexibility on his instruments to pull off just about anything he thinks of. So I love playing with Ken. And Bucky I enjoy playing with. There’s a lot of different things.
